replies.text:
Checks (step 2):
- Automated abuse reachable: "Anyone can create a seller account" and photos uploaded to server — covered by listed threats 1 (mass sign-up) and 4 (upload flooding).
- Staff/admin/moderator screens showing user-supplied content: design names no admin, moderation or support screen — not present in design.
- Delete/moderate/refund/role-change without a record: no such action stated; however "The app keeps the full chat history on the phone in a local database" plus "Anyone can create a seller account" means no server-side record of who sent what — not covered by the list.
- Personal documents cacheable by browsers/proxies/CDN: design says only "Photos are uploaded to our server and shown in the other person's chat"; no page, CDN or document delivery stated — not present.
- Attacker text into logs, CSV/exports, emails, headers: no export, email or log path stated — not present.
- Single-reviewer threats 1–3 (client-supplied conversation/sender id): design never states that the client sends a conversation, recipient or sender id; these rest on how it would be built — excluded.
- Single-reviewer threat 4 (no chat evidence/retention): real per the quotes above — included.
